        <title>飞途旅游订单系统</title>
    <link rel="preload" href="/vendor/bootstrap-icons/fonts/bootstrap-icons.woff2" as="font" type="font/woff2" crossorigin>

        <style>
                :root {
            --sidebar-width: 170px;
            --primary: #3b82f6; --primary-light: #eff6ff;
            --success: #10b981; --warning: #f59e0b; --danger: #ef4444;
            --bg: #f5f7fb; --surface: #ffffff;
            --border: #eef1f5; --border-hover: #d1d5db;
            --text: #1a1a2e; --text-secondary: #4b5563; --muted: #6b7280;
            --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.03);
            --shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.04),0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.02);
            --shadow-md: 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.05),0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.03);
            --radius-sm: 8px; --radius: 12px; --radius-lg: 16px;
            --input-h: 38px;
        }
        * { box-sizing: border-box; }

        body {
            font-size: .875rem;
            background: var(--bg);
            color: var(--text);
            overflow-x: hidden;
            font-family: -apple-system, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", sans-serif;
            -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
        }

        /* ===== Sidebar (Dark - default) ===== */
        .sidebar {
            position:fixed;top:0;bottom:0;left:0;width:var(--sidebar-width);z-index:100;
            background:#111827;display:flex;flex-direction:column;
            transition:transform .3s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
        }
        .sidebar .brand{padding:1.3rem 1.2rem;color:#fff;font-size:.85rem;font-weight:700;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);text-align:center;letter-spacing:.02em;transition:all .3s}
        .sidebar .nav-link{color:#9ca3af;padding:.5rem 1rem .5rem 1.2rem;font-size:.82rem;border-left:2.5px solid transparent;transition:all .15s ease;text-decoration:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.55rem;margin:1px .6rem;border-radius:0 8px 8px 0;flex-shrink:0}
        .sidebar .nav-link:hover{color:#e5e7eb;background:rgba(255,255,255,.03)}
        .sidebar .nav-link.active{color:#fff;background:rgba(59,130,246,.1);border-left-color:var(--primary)}
        .sidebar .nav-link i{font-size:.9rem;opacity:.7;width:1.1rem;text-align:center}
        .sidebar .nav-link.active i{opacity:1;color:var(--primary)}
        .sidebar .nav-section{color:#4b5563;font-size:.6rem;text-transform:uppercase;padding:.9rem 1.2rem .3rem;letter-spacing:.12em;font-weight:700;flex-shrink:0}
        .sidebar .sidebar-footer{padding:.6rem 1.2rem;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05);color:#4b5563;font-size:.65rem;text-align:center}

        /* ===== Sidebar (Light theme) ===== */
        .sidebar-light { background:#fff;border-right:1px solid #eef2f7; }
        .sidebar-light .brand { color:#1e293b;border-bottom:1px solid #eef2f7; }
        .sidebar-light .nav-link { color:#64748b; }
        .sidebar-light .nav-link:hover { color:#334155;background:#f8fafc; }
        .sidebar-light .nav-link.active { color:#3b82f6;background:#eff6ff; }
        .sidebar-light .nav-section { color:#94a3b8; }
        .sidebar-light .sidebar-footer { color:#94a3b8;border-top:1px solid #eef2f7; }

        /* ===== Main ===== */
        .main{margin-left:var(--sidebar-width);min-height:100vh;overflow-x:hidden}
        .navbar-top{background:var(--surface);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);padding:.5rem 1.5rem;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;min-height:48px}
        .content{padding:1rem 1.25rem}
        .navbar-toggle-btn { display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:.4rem;padding:.3rem .5rem;background:#fff;cursor:pointer; }
        .navbar-toggle-btn i { font-size:1.2rem; }
        .navbar-quote { background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fffbeb,#fef3c7);border:1px solid #fde68a;border-radius:2rem;font-size:.78rem;color:#92400e;font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap; }
        .navbar-quote i { color:#f59e0b;font-size:.85rem; }

        /* ===== Cards ===== */
        .stat-card {
            border: none; border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
            transition: all .25s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); cursor: default;
            background: var(--surface);
        }
        .stat-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }
        .stat-card .stat-icon {
            width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: .65rem;
            display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
            font-size: 1.35rem; flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        /* ===== Status badges ===== */
        .badge-status { font-size: .73rem; padding: .28em .6em; border-radius: 20px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: .02em; }
        .badge-draft { background: #f1f5f9; color: #475569; }
        .badge-pending { background: #fef9c3; color: #a16207; }
        .badge-active { background: #dbeafe; color: #1d4ed8; }
        .badge-booking { background: #ffedd5; color: #c2410c; }
        .badge-completed { background: #d1fae5; color: #065f46; }
        .badge-cancelled { background: #fee2e2; color: #991b1b; }
        .badge-approved { background: #d1fae5; color: #065f46; }
        .badge-rejected { background: #fee2e2; color: #991b1b; }
        .badge-confirmed { background: #dcfce7; color: #166534; }
        .badge-paid { background: #fee2e2; color: #991b1b; }
        /* payment status */
        .badge-review-ok { background: #dbeafe; color: #1d4ed8; }
        .badge-done { background: #dcfce7; color: #166534; }

        /* ===== Timeline ===== */
        .timeline { position: relative; padding-left: 2.2rem; }
        .timeline::before {
            content: ''; position: absolute; left: .55rem;
            top: 8px; bottom: 8px; width: 2px;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--success) 0%, var(--primary) 50%, var(--danger) 100%);
            border-radius: 1px;
        }
        .timeline-item {
            position: relative; margin-bottom: 1rem;
            padding: .75rem 1rem; border-radius: .6rem;
            background: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid #f1f5f9;
            transition: all .2s ease;
        }
        .timeline-item:hover { background: #fff; border-color: #e2e8f0; box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); }
        .timeline-item::before {
            content: ''; position: absolute; left: -1.82rem; top: .85rem;
            width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%;
            border: 2.5px solid #fff;
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #94a3b8;
        }
        .timeline-item.income::before { background: var(--success); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--success); }
        .timeline-item.expense::before { background: var(--danger); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--danger); }

        /* ===== Progress Bar ===== */
        .fund-progress { height: 26px; border-radius: 13px; font-size: .72rem; background: #f1f5f9; overflow: hidden; }
        .fund-progress .progress-bar { transition: width .6s ease; font-weight: 600; line-height: 26px; }

        /* ===== Layout Components ===== */
        .sidebar-logo{height:52px;margin-bottom:8px}.sidebar:not(.sidebar-light) .sidebar-logo{border-radius:8px}.sidebar-nav-wrap{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:.5rem 0;scrollbar-gutter:stable}.sidebar-nav-wrap::-webkit-scrollbar{width:6px}.sidebar-nav-wrap::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:transparent}.sidebar-nav-wrap::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:transparent;border-radius:3px}.sidebar-nav-wrap:hover::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:rgba(255,255,255,.18)}.sidebar-light .sidebar-nav-wrap:hover::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:rgba(0,0,0,.15)}
        .notif-dropdown{border-radius:.6rem;border:none;min-width:260px;max-height:360px;overflow-y:auto}.notif-dropdown-sm{border-radius:.5rem;border:none}
        .lightbox-dialog{max-width:fit-content;min-width:300px}.lightbox-img{max-width:100%;max-height:78vh;border-radius:.5rem;cursor:zoom-in;box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.12);transition:transform .2s;user-select:none}
        .lightbox-nav{display:none;text-decoration:none;z-index:1;width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(0,0,0,.45);color:#fff;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
        .lightbox-close{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(0,0,0,.45);color:#fff;border:none;position:absolute;top:12px;right:12px;z-index:2;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;font-size:1.1rem;line-height:1;transition:all .15s}
        .lightbox-body{padding:0 1rem .5rem;background:#f1f5f9}
        .confirm-icon{width:56px;height:56px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fef3c7,#fde68a)}
        .confirm-btn-cancel{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f1f5f9,#e2e8f0);color:#475569;border:none;border-radius:.6rem;font-size:.82rem;font-weight:500;transition:all .2s}
        .confirm-btn-danger{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ef4444,#dc2626);color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:.6rem;font-size:.82rem;font-weight:600;transition:all .2s}
        .alert-clean{border:none;border-radius:.5rem}.navbar-btn{border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:.4rem;padding:.3rem .5rem;background:#fff;cursor:pointer}
        .navbar-user-btn{border:1px solid #e2e8f0;height:32px}.info-banner{border-radius:0;border:none;background:#eff6ff;border-bottom:1px solid #bfdbfe!important;font-size:.75rem}
        .warn-banner{border-radius:0;border:none;background:#fffbeb;border-bottom:2px solid #f59e0b!important;position:sticky;top:48px;z-index:45}

        /* ===== Cards & Content ===== */
        .card{border:none;border-radius:var(--radius-lg);box-shadow:var(--shadow);background:var(--surface)}
.card-body.p-0{overflow:hidden;border-radius:inherit}
        .card-header{background:transparent;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);padding:.7rem 1.2rem;font-weight:600;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--text)}


        /* ===== Buttons ===== */
        .btn{display:inline-flex!important;align-items:center!important;border-radius:var(--radius-sm);font-size:.84rem;font-weight:550;transition:all .15s ease;white-space:nowrap;gap:.3rem}
        .btn-sm{border-radius:var(--radius-sm);font-size:.78rem;padding:.25rem .65rem}
        .btn-primary { box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(59,130,246,.3); }
        .btn-primary:hover { box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(59,130,246,.35); transform: translateY(-1px); }

        /* === Action button COLORS (Bootstrap handles all sizing) === */
        .btn-edit { background: #ecfdf5; color: #059669; border-color: #a7f3d0; }
        .btn-edit:hover { background: #d1fae5; color: #047857; border-color: #6ee7b7; box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(16,185,129,.2); transform: translateY(-1px); }
        .btn-delete { background: #fef2f2; color: #dc2626; border-color: #fecaca; }
        .btn-delete:hover { background: #fee2e2; color: #b91c1c; border-color: #fca5a5; box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(239,68,68,.2); transform: translateY(-1px); }
        .btn-add { background: #eff6ff; color: #3b82f6; border-color: #bfdbfe; }
        .btn-add:hover { background: #dbeafe; color: #1d4ed8; border-color: #93c5fd; box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(59,130,246,.2); transform: translateY(-1px); }
        .btn-view { background: #eff6ff; color: #2563eb; border-color: #bfdbfe; }
        .btn-view:hover { background: #dbeafe; color: #1d4ed8; border-color: #93c5fd; box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(59,130,246,.2); transform: translateY(-1px); }
        .btn-approve { background: #ecfdf5; color: #059669; border-color: #a7f3d0; }
        .btn-approve:hover { background: #d1fae5; color: #047857; border-color: #6ee7b7; box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(16,185,129,.2); transform: translateY(-1px); }
        .btn-reject { background: #fef2f2; color: #dc2626; border-color: #fecaca; }
        .btn-reject:hover { background: #fee2e2; color: #b91c1c; border-color: #fca5a5; box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(239,68,68,.2); transform: translateY(-1px); }
        .btn-submit { background: #fffbeb; color: #d97706; border-color: #fde68a; }
        .btn-submit:hover { background: #fef3c7; color: #b45309; border-color: #fcd34d; box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(245,158,11,.2); transform: translateY(-1px); }

        /* ===== Global utility classes (inline for zero FOUC) ===== */
.tx-xxs{font-size:.68rem}.tx-xs{font-size:.7rem}.tx-sm{font-size:.72rem}.tx-s{font-size:.75rem}.tx-m{font-size:.78rem}.tx-base{font-size:.8rem}.tx-md{font-size:.82rem}.tx-85{font-size:.85rem}.tx-lg{font-size:1.2rem}
.fw-400{font-weight:400}.fw-500{font-weight:500}.fw-600{font-weight:600}.fw-700{font-weight:700}
.c-dark{color:#1e293b}.c-muted{color:#64748b}.c-sub{color:#94a3b8}.c-text{color:#475569}
.c-green{color:#065f46}.c-emerald{color:#10b981}.c-red{color:#991b1b}.c-danger{color:#ef4444}.c-blue{color:#5b8def}.c-blue-dark{color:#1e40af}.c-purple{color:#5b21b6}.c-violet{color:#8b5cf6}.c-amber{color:#f59e0b}.c-sky{color:#38bdf8}
.bg-slate{background:#f8fafc}.bg-green-light{background:#d1fae5}.bg-red-light{background:#fee2e2}.bg-blue-light{background:#dbeafe}.bg-emerald-light{background:#ecfdf5}.bg-red-pale{background:#fef2f2}.bg-amber-light{background:#fffbeb}.bg-purple-light{background:#f5f3ff}

/* === Solid header buttons (color only) === */
        .btn-green { background: #10b981; color: #fff; border-color: #10b981; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(16,185,129,.3); }
        .btn-green:hover { background: #059669; color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(16,185,129,.35); transform: translateY(-1px); }
        .btn-red { background: #ef4444; color: #fff; border-color: #ef4444; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(239,68,68,.3); }
        .btn-red:hover { background: #dc2626; color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(239,68,68,.35); transform: translateY(-1px); }
        .btn-amber { background: #f59e0b; color: #fff; border-color: #f59e0b; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(245,158,11,.3); }
        .btn-amber:hover { background: #d97706; color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(245,158,11,.35); transform: translateY(-1px); }
        .btn-blue { background: #5b8def; color: #fff; border-color: #5b8def; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(91,141,239,.3); }
        .btn-blue:hover { background: #3b78e7; color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(91,141,239,.35); transform: translateY(-1px); }

        /* === Outline buttons (color only) === */
        .btn-ored { background: #fef2f2; color: #ef4444; border-color: #fecaca; }
        .btn-ored:hover { background: #fee2e2; color: #dc2626; }
        .btn-ogreen { background: #ecfdf5; color: #10b981; border-color: #a7f3d0; }
        .btn-ogreen:hover { background: #d1fae5; color: #059669; }

        /* === Misc === */
        .btn-muted { background: #f8fafc; border-color: #e2e8f0; color: #64748b; }
        .btn-muted:hover { background: #f1f5f9; color: #475569; }
        .btn-danger-fill { background: #ef4444; color: #fff; border-color: #ef4444; }
        .btn-danger-fill:hover { background: #dc2626; color: #fff; border-color: #dc2626; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(239,68,68,.3); }

        /* ===== Table ===== */
        .table{margin-bottom:0;font-size:.84rem}
        .table-hover>tbody>tr{transition:background .12s ease}
        .table-hover>tbody>tr:hover{background:#f8fafc}
        .table thead th{border-top:none;border-bottom:2px solid var(--border);font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);font-size:.75rem;letter-spacing:.02em;padding:.65rem 1rem;background:#fafbfc;text-transform:uppercase}
        .table td{vertical-align:middle;padding:.6rem 1rem;border-bottom:1px solid #f8fafc;color:var(--text);font-size:.82rem}
        /* ===== Orders table - tighter padding to fit more columns ===== */
        .table-compact thead th { padding-left: .75rem; padding-right: .75rem; }
        .table-compact td { padding-left: .75rem; padding-right: .75rem; }

        /* ===== Filter tabs ===== */
        .filter-tabs { display: flex; gap: .3rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
        .filter-tabs .btn { border-radius: 20px; font-size: .8rem; padding: .25rem .8rem; }

        /* ===== Form controls ===== */
        .form-control,.form-select,.form-control-sm,.form-select-sm{border:1px solid var(--border-hover);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);transition:all .15s ease;font-size:.84rem;height:var(--input-h);padding:0 .75rem;color:var(--text);background:var(--surface)}
        ::placeholder{color:#cbd5e1!important;opacity:1}
        input:focus::placeholder,textarea:focus::placeholder{color:#e2e8f0!important}
        .form-control-sm,.form-select-sm{border-radius:var(--radius-sm);font-size:.8rem;height:36px}
        .form-control:focus,.form-select:focus{border-color:var(--primary);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(59,130,246,.15);outline:none}
        .form-control:hover:not(:focus),.form-select:hover:not(:focus){border-color:var(--border-hover)}
        .form-control-sm,.form-select-sm{border-radius:var(--radius-sm);font-size:.8rem;height:36px}
        .form-label{font-weight:600;color:var(--text-secondary);margin-bottom:.25rem;font-size:.78rem}
        .input-group-text { border-color: var(--border); background: #f8fafc; font-size: .84rem; }

        /* ===== 平板+手机：侧边栏折叠为汉堡菜单（桌面≥1200px 才常驻侧边栏）===== */
        @media (max-width: 1199.98px) {
            .sidebar { transform: translateX(-100%); }
            .sidebar.show { transform: translateX(0); }
            .sidebar-overlay.show { display: block; }
            .main { margin-left: 0; }
        }
        /* ===== 手机：紧凑内容样式 ===== */
        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .content { padding: .875rem .75rem; }
            .navbar-top { padding: .4rem .75rem; }
            .navbar-top .btn { font-size:.7rem; }
            /* stat cards: 2 per row */
            .stat-card .stat-icon { width:36px;height:36px;font-size:1rem; }
            .stat-card .card-body { padding:.5rem .6rem!important; }
            /* tables: enable horizontal scroll */
            .table-responsive { -webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch; }
            table { min-width:600px; }
            /* group card headers: stack vertically */
            .rv-group-hdr { gap:.3rem;padding:.4rem .5rem; }
            .rv-group-hdr > * { font-size: .7rem!important; }
            /* payment/order group rows */
            .rv-pay-row { padding:.35rem .5rem .35rem 1.6rem;gap:.35rem; }
            .rv-pay-row::before { left:.75rem; }
            .rv-pay-row::after { left:.75rem;width:.45rem; }
            /* forms */
            .form-control,.form-select { height:36px;font-size:.8rem; }
            /* hero/header areas */
            .rounded-4.py-2.px-3 { padding:.5rem .75rem!important; }
        }
        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            #lightboxModal .modal-dialog{max-width:100vw!important;margin:0}
            #lightboxModal .modal-content{border-radius:0!important}
            #lightboxModal .modal-body{padding:0!important}
            #lightboxModal #lightboxImage{max-height:85vh;border-radius:0!important}
            #eventDetailModal .modal-content{border-radius:0!important}
            #eventDetailModal .modal-dialog{max-width:100%!important;margin:0}
            #eventDetailModal .modal-content{border-radius:0!important}
            #eventDetailBody{font-size:.78rem!important;line-height:1.6!important;overflow-x:hidden!important}
            #eventDetailBody *{max-width:100%!important;word-break:break-word}
            #eventDetailBody td{width:auto!important;display:block!important}
            #eventDetailBody td[style*="width"]{width:auto!important}
            #eventDetailBody tr{display:flex!important;flex-wrap:wrap!important}
        }
        #lightboxPrev:hover,#lightboxNext:hover{background:rgba(0,0,0,.7)!important;transform:translateY(-50%) scale(1.1)!important}
        #lightboxModal .modal-header button:hover{background:rgba(0,0,0,.7)!important;transform:scale(1.15)!important}
        @media (max-width: 480px) {
            .content { padding: .4rem; }
            .stat-card .stat-num { font-size:1rem!important; }
            .stat-card .stat-label { font-size:.58rem!important; }
            .btn-sm { font-size:.7rem;padding:.2rem .5rem; }
        }

// ===== 通用输入框实时查重 =====
function checkUnique(table, field, value, warnId, excludeId) {
    if (!value || value.length < 2) { var el = document.getElementById(warnId); if (el) el.style.display = 'none'; return; }
    var url = 'https://trip.lipseo.com/check-unique?table=' + table + '&field=' + field + '&value=' + encodeURIComponent(value);
    if (excludeId) url += '&exclude_id=' + excludeId;
    fetch(url).then(function (r) { return r.json() }).then(function (d) {
        var el = document.getElementById(warnId); if (el) el.style.display = d.exists ? '' : 'none';
    });
}
// ===== Toast notification system =====
function showToast(message, type = 'success') {
    const container = document.getElementById('toastContainer');
    const toast = document.createElement('div');
    toast.className = `toast-custom ${type}`;
    const icon = type === 'success' ? 'bi-check-circle-fill text-success' : 'bi-exclamation-triangle-fill text-danger';
    toast.innerHTML = `<i class="bi ${icon}"></i><span>${message}</span>`;
    container.appendChild(toast);
    setTimeout(() => { toast.style.opacity = '0'; toast.style.transition = 'opacity .3s'; setTimeout(() => toast.remove(), 300); }, 5000);
}

// ===== Confirmation dialog =====
function confirmAction(message, callback) {
    if (confirm(message)) callback();
}

        setTimeout(function() { el.classList.remove('show'); setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 300); }, 6000);
    });
});

// ===== 自定义日期选择器 (零依赖) =====
(function() {
    var MONTHS = ['一月','二月','三月','四月','五月','六月','七月','八月','九月','十月','十一月','十二月'];
    var WEEKDAYS = ['一','二','三','四','五','六','日'];

    function ymd(d) { return d.getFullYear()+'-'+String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0'); }
    function parse(v) { if (!v) return new Date(); var p = v.split('-'); return new Date(+p[0], +p[1]-1, +p[2]); }

    function buildCalendar(input) {
        var cal = document.createElement('div'); cal.className = 'dtp-calendar';

        // Header
        var hdr = document.createElement('div'); hdr.className = 'dtp-header';
        var prevYear = document.createElement('button'); prevYear.className = 'dtp-arrow dtp-double'; prevYear.innerHTML = '«'; prevYear.title = '上一年';
        var prevMonth = document.createElement('button'); prevMonth.className = 'dtp-arrow'; prevMonth.innerHTML = '‹'; prevMonth.title = '上一月';
        var labelArea = document.createElement('div'); labelArea.className = 'dtp-label-area';
        var yearLabel = document.createElement('span'); yearLabel.className = 'dtp-label';
        var monthLabel = document.createElement('span'); monthLabel.className = 'dtp-label';
        labelArea.appendChild(monthLabel); labelArea.appendChild(yearLabel);
        var nextMonth = document.createElement('button'); nextMonth.className = 'dtp-arrow'; nextMonth.innerHTML = '›'; nextMonth.title = '下一月';
        var nextYear = document.createElement('button'); nextYear.className = 'dtp-arrow dtp-double'; nextYear.innerHTML = '»'; nextYear.title = '下一年';
        hdr.appendChild(prevYear); hdr.appendChild(prevMonth);
        hdr.appendChild(labelArea);
        hdr.appendChild(nextMonth); hdr.appendChild(nextYear);

        // Select panels
        var monthPanel = document.createElement('div'); monthPanel.className = 'dtp-select-panel';
        var monthGrid = document.createElement('div'); monthGrid.className = 'dtp-select-grid months';
        monthPanel.appendChild(monthGrid);
        var yearPanel = document.createElement('div'); yearPanel.className = 'dtp-select-panel';
        var yearGrid = document.createElement('div'); yearGrid.className = 'dtp-select-grid years';
        yearPanel.appendChild(yearGrid);

        // Weekday row
        var wkRow = document.createElement('div'); wkRow.className = 'dtp-weekdays';
        WEEKDAYS.forEach(function(d) { var s = document.createElement('span'); s.textContent = d; wkRow.appendChild(s); });

        // Day grid
        var dayGrid = document.createElement('div'); dayGrid.className = 'dtp-days';

        // Footer
        var footer = document.createElement('div'); footer.className = 'dtp-footer';
        var clearBtn = document.createElement('button'); clearBtn.textContent = '清除'; clearBtn.type = 'button';
        var todayBtn = document.createElement('button'); todayBtn.textContent = '今天'; todayBtn.className = 'dtp-today'; todayBtn.type = 'button';
        footer.appendChild(clearBtn); footer.appendChild(todayBtn);

        cal.appendChild(hdr); cal.appendChild(monthPanel); cal.appendChild(yearPanel);
        cal.appendChild(wkRow); cal.appendChild(dayGrid); cal.appendChild(footer);
        document.body.appendChild(cal);

        var state = { year: 0, month: 0, day: 0, showMonthPanel: false, showYearPanel: false };

        function hidePanels() { monthPanel.classList.remove('show'); yearPanel.classList.remove('show'); state.showMonthPanel = false; state.showYearPanel = false; }

        function renderDays() {
            yearLabel.textContent = state.year + '年';
            monthLabel.textContent = MONTHS[state.month];

            // Month select panel
            monthGrid.innerHTML = '';
            MONTHS.forEach(function(m, i) {
                var btn = document.createElement('button'); btn.textContent = (i+1) + '月'; btn.type = 'button';
                if (i === state.month) btn.classList.add('active');
                btn.addEventListener('click', function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); state.month = i; hidePanels(); renderDays(); });
                monthGrid.appendChild(btn);
            });

            // Year select panel
            yearGrid.innerHTML = '';
            var yStart = state.year - 5;
            for (var i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
                var y = yStart + i;
                var btn = document.createElement('button'); btn.textContent = y; btn.type = 'button';
                if (y === state.year) btn.classList.add('active');
                (function(yy) {
                    btn.addEventListener('click', function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); state.year = yy; hidePanels(); renderDays(); });
                })(y);
                yearGrid.appendChild(btn);
            }

            // Day cells
            dayGrid.innerHTML = '';
            var firstDay = new Date(state.year, state.month, 1);
            var startDay = firstDay.getDay() || 7; // Mon=1..Sun=7
            var daysInMonth = new Date(state.year, state.month + 1, 0).getDate();
            var prevDays = new Date(state.year, state.month, 0).getDate();
            var today = new Date(); today.setHours(0,0,0,0);

            // Previous month fill
            for (var i = startDay - 2; i >= 0; i--) {
                var d = prevDays - i;
                var btn = document.createElement('button'); btn.textContent = d; btn.type = 'button';
                btn.classList.add('other-month');
                (function(yy, mm, dd) {
                    btn.addEventListener('click', function() { state.year = yy; state.month = mm; state.day = dd; selectDate(); });
                })(state.month === 0 ? state.year - 1 : state.year, state.month === 0 ? 11 : state.month - 1, d);
                dayGrid.appendChild(btn);
            }

            // Current month
            for (var i = 1; i <= daysInMonth; i++) {
                var btn = document.createElement('button'); btn.textContent = i; btn.type = 'button';
                var cellDate = new Date(state.year, state.month, i); cellDate.setHours(0,0,0,0);
                if (cellDate.getTime() === today.getTime()) btn.classList.add('today');
                if (i === state.day) btn.classList.add('selected');
                (function(dd) {
                    btn.addEventListener('click', function() { state.day = dd; selectDate(); });
                })(i);
                dayGrid.appendChild(btn);
            }

            // Next month fill
            var remaining = 42 - (startDay - 1) - daysInMonth;
            for (var i = 1; i <= remaining; i++) {
                var btn = document.createElement('button'); btn.textContent = i; btn.type = 'button';
                btn.classList.add('other-month');
                (function(yy, mm, dd) {
                    btn.addEventListener('click', function() { state.year = yy; state.month = mm; state.day = dd; selectDate(); });
                })(state.month === 11 ? state.year + 1 : state.year, state.month === 11 ? 0 : state.month + 1, i);
                dayGrid.appendChild(btn);
            }
        }

        function selectDate() {
            if (!state.day) { state.day = new Date(state.year, state.month + 1, 0).getDate(); }
            input.value = state.year + '-' + String(state.month + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '-' + String(state.day).padStart(2, '0');
            hidePanels();
            renderDays();
            cal.classList.remove('show');
            input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
        }

        // Event handlers
        prevYear.addEventListener('click', function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); state.year--; state.day = 0; renderDays(); });
        prevMonth.addEventListener('click', function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); state.month--; if (state.month < 0) { state.month = 11; state.year--; } state.day = 0; renderDays(); });
        nextMonth.addEventListener('click', function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); state.month++; if (state.month > 11) { state.month = 0; state.year++; } state.day = 0; renderDays(); });
        nextYear.addEventListener('click', function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); state.year++; state.day = 0; renderDays(); });

        monthLabel.addEventListener('click', function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); yearPanel.classList.remove('show'); state.showYearPanel = false; monthPanel.classList.toggle('show'); state.showMonthPanel = !state.showMonthPanel; });
        yearLabel.addEventListener('click', function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); monthPanel.classList.remove('show'); state.showMonthPanel = false; yearPanel.classList.toggle('show'); state.showYearPanel = !state.showYearPanel; });

        todayBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); var t = new Date(); state.year = t.getFullYear(); state.month = t.getMonth(); state.day = t.getDate(); selectDate(); });
        clearBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); input.value = ''; state.day = 0; hidePanels(); cal.classList.remove('show'); renderDays(); input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); });

        input.addEventListener('click', function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); show(); });
        input.addEventListener('focus', function(e) { show(); });

        document.addEventListener('click', function(e) { if (!cal.contains(e.target) && e.target !== input) { cal.classList.remove('show'); hidePanels(); } });

        function show() {
            if (cal.classList.contains('show')) return;
            var rect = input.getBoundingClientRect();
            cal.style.top = (rect.bottom + window.scrollY + 4) + 'px';
            cal.style.left = (rect.left + window.scrollX) + 'px';
            if (rect.bottom + 400 > window.innerHeight) cal.style.top = (rect.top + window.scrollY - 400 - 4) + 'px';
            if (rect.left + 300 > window.innerWidth) cal.style.left = (rect.right + window.scrollX - 296) + 'px';

            // Init state from input value
            var d = input.value ? parse(input.value) : new Date();
            state.year = d.getFullYear(); state.month = d.getMonth(); state.day = d.getDate();
            renderDays();
            cal.classList.add('show');
            hidePanels();
            // Close other calendars
            document.querySelectorAll('.dtp-calendar.show').forEach(function(c) { if (c !== cal) c.classList.remove('show'); });
        }

        return cal;
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        document.querySelectorAll('.datepicker').forEach(function(input) {
            if (input._dtpInited) return; input._dtpInited = true;
            buildCalendar(input);
        });
    });
})();

// ===== 通用可搜索下拉（searchable-select 公共组件，全局定义，页面可覆盖）=====
function toggleDropdown(id){var dd=document.getElementById(id).querySelector('.searchable-dropdown'),o=dd.classList.contains('show');closeAllDropdowns();if(!o){dd.classList.add('show');var inp=dd.querySelector('.searchable-input');if(inp){inp.focus({preventScroll:true});inp.select();filterDropdown(id,'')}}}

function closeAllDropdowns(){document.querySelectorAll('.searchable-dropdown.show').forEach(function(d){d.classList.remove('show')})}
function filterDropdown(id,kw){var c=document.getElementById(id);if(!c)return;var kwl=(kw||'').toLowerCase();var hook=c.getAttribute('data-filter-hook'),fn=hook&&window[hook]?window[hook]:null;var has=false;c.querySelectorAll('.searchable-option').forEach(function(o){var ok=fn?fn(o,kwl):(!kwl||o.textContent.toLowerCase().indexOf(kwl)>=0);o.style.display=ok?'':'none';if(ok)has=true});var e=c.querySelector('.searchable-empty');if(!has){if(!e){e=document.createElement('div');e.className='searchable-empty';e.textContent='无匹配';c.querySelector('.searchable-options').appendChild(e)}e.style.display=''}else if(e){e.style.display='none'}}
function selectDropdown(id,option){var c=document.getElementById(id);if(!c)return;var v=option.getAttribute('data-value')||'';var label=option.getAttribute('data-label')||option.textContent.trim();var te=c.querySelector('.searchable-text');if(te){te.textContent=label||'请选择';te.classList.toggle('has-value',!!v)}var hidden=c.querySelector('input[type=hidden]');if(hidden)hidden.value=v;var map=c.getAttribute('data-map');if(map){map.split(',').forEach(function(pair){var p=pair.split(':');if(p.length===2){var el=document.getElementById(p[1].trim());if(el)el.value=option.getAttribute('data-'+p[0].trim())||''}})}c.querySelectorAll('.searchable-option').forEach(function(o){o.classList.remove('selected')});option.classList.add('selected');c.querySelector('.searchable-dropdown').classList.remove('show');var inp=c.querySelector('.searchable-input');if(inp)inp.value='';var hook=c.getAttribute('data-select-hook');if(hook&&window[hook])window[hook](option,v);if(c.getAttribute('data-submit')==='1'&&c.closest('form'))c.closest('form').submit()}
document.addEventListener('click',function(e){if(!e.target.closest('.searchable-select'))closeAllDropdowns()});
</script>

// 列宽：两侧关键列固定像素宽（勾选/订单号/操作，不随屏幕缩放），中间列按权重分配弹性区；窄屏中间横滚+两侧吸顶+动态阴影
(function(){
    var table=document.getElementById('ordersTable');
    if(!table)return;
    var FIXED_KEY='order_col_fixed_v1', MID_KEY='order_col_mid_v1';
    var FIXED_DEF={cb:30,order_no:140,actions:160};
    var FIXED_MIN={cb:24,order_no:100,actions:120};
    var FIXED_MAX={cb:60,order_no:260,actions:320};
    var cols=[],byKey={},middle=[];
    table.querySelectorAll('thead th[data-col]').forEach(function(th){
        var k=th.getAttribute('data-col');
        var c={key:k,th:th,col:null,def:parseFloat(th.getAttribute('data-weight'))||8,minPx:0,minWidth:minPxOf(th),fixed:th.getAttribute('data-fixed')==='1'};
        byKey[k]=c;cols.push(c);
        if(!c.fixed)middle.push(c);
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('#ordersColgroup col').forEach(function(col){
        var k=col.getAttribute('data-col');
        if(k&&byKey[k])byKey[k].col=col;
    });
    function minPxOf(el){var v=window.getComputedStyle(el).minWidth;var n=parseFloat(v);return(v&&v!=='auto'&&!isNaN(n))?n:0;}
    // 收缩下限：COL_FLOOR 为常规目标，SHRINK_MIN 为空间紧张时的绝对下限（保证表格永远放得下、不出横向滚动条）
    var COL_FLOOR=40, SHRINK_MIN=24;
    function tableW(){
        // 以 .table-responsive 容器可见宽度为准，避免表格自身被 min-width 撑宽后取到溢出宽度，导致一直超宽
        var wr=table.closest('.table-responsive');
        var w=wr?wr.clientWidth:0;
        return w||table.clientWidth||table.getBoundingClientRect().width||0;
    }
    // 统一写列宽：低于 CSS 最小宽时放开 th 的 min-width，否则 shrink 不生效；并同步生效最小宽供拖拽使用
    function applyWidths(out){
        middle.forEach(function(c){
            var w=Math.max(SHRINK_MIN,out[c.key]||0);
            setW(c,w+'px');
            var mw=(c.minWidth&&w<c.minWidth)?w+'px':'';
            if(c.th.style.minWidth!==mw)c.th.style.minWidth=mw;
            c.minPx=mw?w:c.minWidth;
        });
    }
    function ls(k,d){try{var v=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(k));return(v&&typeof v==='object')?v:d;}catch(e){return d;}}
    // 记住排序选择到 cookie（ovOrderSort=col|dir），与 ovPerPage 同模式，切页/回访后保持
    function ovRememberSort(col, dir){try{document.cookie='ovOrderSort='+encodeURIComponent(col+'|'+dir)+';path=/;max-age=31536000';}catch(e){}}
    function setW(c,w){var el=c.col||c.th;if(el)el.style.width=w;}
    function curPx(c){return c.th.offsetWidth||0;}
    function clamp(v,a,b){return Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));}
    function fixedTotal(f){return f.cb+f.order_no+f.actions;}
    function readFixed(){
        var f=ls(FIXED_KEY,FIXED_DEF);
        return {
            cb:clamp(f.cb||FIXED_DEF.cb,FIXED_MIN.cb,FIXED_MAX.cb),
            order_no:clamp(f.order_no||FIXED_DEF.order_no,FIXED_MIN.order_no,FIXED_MAX.order_no),
            actions:clamp(f.actions||FIXED_DEF.actions,FIXED_MIN.actions,FIXED_MAX.actions)
        };
    }
    // 中间列分配：在 available 内按 desired 分配，每列 >= 最小宽度；下限总和放不下则自然溢出（横向滚动）
    function distribute(desired,available){
        var out={};
        middle.forEach(function(c){out[c.key]=Math.max(c.minPx,desired[c.key]||0);});
        var sum=0;middle.forEach(function(c){sum+=out[c.key];});
        if(sum>available+0.5){
            // 容器过窄：按比例收缩到可用宽度（最低可到 SHRINK_MIN），保证不出横向滚动条
            var need=sum-available;
            for(var k=0;k<8&&need>0.5;k++){
                var sh=0;
                middle.forEach(function(c){if(out[c.key]>SHRINK_MIN+0.5)sh+=(out[c.key]-SHRINK_MIN);});
                if(sh<=0)break;
                middle.forEach(function(c){
                    if(out[c.key]>SHRINK_MIN+0.5){
                        out[c.key]-=need*(out[c.key]-SHRINK_MIN)/sh;
                    }
                });
                sum=0;middle.forEach(function(c){sum+=out[c.key];});
                need=sum-available;
            }
        } else if(sum<available-0.5){
            var slack=available-sum;
            for(var i=0;i<8&&slack>0.5;i++){
                var flex=0;middle.forEach(function(c){if(out[c.key]>c.minPx+0.5)flex+=out[c.key];});
                if(flex<=0)break;
                middle.forEach(function(c){if(out[c.key]>c.minPx+0.5)out[c.key]+=slack*out[c.key]/flex;});
                sum=0;middle.forEach(function(c){sum+=out[c.key];});
                slack=available-sum;
            }
        }
        return out;
    }
    // 拖拽中间列：被拖列 = newPx，其余列分摊剩余空间并受下限约束
    function dragMiddle(target,newPx,flexible){
        var out={};out[target.key]=newPx;
        var others=middle.filter(function(c){return c!==target;});
        var oCur=0;others.forEach(function(c){oCur+=curPx(c);});
        var scale=oCur>0?(flexible-newPx)/oCur:1;
        // 下限用 SHRINK_MIN（绝对下限），拖拽时也不会把表格撑出横向滚动条
        others.forEach(function(c){out[c.key]=Math.max(SHRINK_MIN,curPx(c)*scale);});
        var oNew=0;others.forEach(function(c){oNew+=out[c.key];});
        var targetFinal=flexible-oNew;
        if(targetFinal<SHRINK_MIN)targetFinal=SHRINK_MIN;
        out[target.key]=targetFinal;
        // 其余列收缩后有富余，补给下限以上的列
        var sum2=0;others.forEach(function(c){sum2+=out[c.key];});
        var slack=flexible-out[target.key]-sum2;
        for(var i=0;i<6&&slack>0.5;i++){
            var flex=0;others.forEach(function(c){if(out[c.key]>SHRINK_MIN+0.5)flex+=out[c.key];});
            if(flex<=0)break;
            others.forEach(function(c){if(out[c.key]>SHRINK_MIN+0.5)out[c.key]+=slack*out[c.key]/flex;});
            sum2=0;others.forEach(function(c){sum2+=out[c.key];});
            slack=flexible-out[target.key]-sum2;
        }
        return out;
    }
    // 订单号吸顶的 left 跟随勾选列实际宽度
    function syncSticky(){
        var off=0,isMobile=window.matchMedia&&window.matchMedia('(max-width:767px)').matches;
        if(!isMobile&&byKey['cb']&&byKey['cb'].th.offsetWidth)off=byKey['cb'].th.offsetWidth;
        table.querySelectorAll('.ov-sticky-left2').forEach(function(el){el.style.left=off+'px';});
    }
    function layout(){
        // 取「当前生效」的最小宽：未被收缩时是 CSS ov-cmin，被收缩后是 applyWidths 设的内联值（自适应）
        middle.forEach(function(c){c.minPx=minPxOf(c.th);});
        var tw=tableW();if(tw<=0)tw=1100;
        var fixed=readFixed();
        // 固定列占比上限：固定列太宽会挤压中间列，导致表格溢出出现横向滚动条
        var maxFixed=tw*0.4;
        if(fixedTotal(fixed)>maxFixed){
            var ratio=maxFixed/fixedTotal(fixed);
            fixed={cb:fixed.cb*ratio, order_no:fixed.order_no*ratio, actions:fixed.actions*ratio};
            // 放开固定列 th 的 min-width，允许收缩到上限以内
            byKey['cb'].th.style.minWidth=fixed.cb+'px';
            byKey['order_no'].th.style.minWidth=fixed.order_no+'px';
            byKey['actions'].th.style.minWidth=fixed.actions+'px';
        }
        var flexible=Math.max(0,tw-fixedTotal(fixed));
        var mid=ls(MID_KEY,{});
        var totalW=0;middle.forEach(function(c){totalW+=c.def;});
        var desired={};
        middle.forEach(function(c){
            desired[c.key]=(mid[c.key]!=null)?mid[c.key]*flexible:(totalW>0?c.def/totalW*flexible:0);
        });
        var out=distribute(desired,flexible);
        setW(byKey['cb'],fixed.cb+'px');
        setW(byKey['order_no'],fixed.order_no+'px');
        setW(byKey['actions'],fixed.actions+'px');
        applyWidths(out);
        syncSticky();
    }
    layout();
    // 拖拽手柄
    var cur=null,startX=0,startPx=0;
    cols.forEach(function(c){
        var h=c.th;
        // 吸顶列本身已是 sticky（已定位元素），只有普通列才需转 relative 作为手柄容器
        if(window.getComputedStyle(h).position==='static') h.style.position='relative';
        var handle=document.createElement('div');
        handle.className='ov-resize-handle';
        handle.style.cssText='position:absolute;right:0;top:4px;bottom:4px;width:4px;cursor:col-resize;z-index:4;border-radius:2px;';
        handle.addEventListener('mouseenter',function(){handle.style.background='rgba(59,130,246,.3)';});
        handle.addEventListener('mouseleave',function(){if(!cur)handle.style.background='';});
        h.appendChild(handle);
        handle.addEventListener('mousedown',function(e){
            handle.style.background='rgba(59,130,246,.6)';
            cur=c;startX=e.pageX;startPx=curPx(c);
            e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();
        });
    });
    document.addEventListener('mousemove',function(e){
        if(!cur)return;
        var delta=e.pageX-startX;
        var tw=tableW();if(tw<=0)return;
        if(cur.fixed){
            // 拖动固定列：调整固定像素值并持久化
            var f=readFixed();
            f[cur.key]=clamp(startPx+delta,FIXED_MIN[cur.key]||40,FIXED_MAX[cur.key]||300);
            localStorage.setItem(FIXED_KEY,JSON.stringify(f));
            layout();
        }else{
            // 拖动中间列：在弹性区内重分配
            var fixed=readFixed();
            var flexible=tw-fixedTotal(fixed);
            var maxNew=Math.max(cur.minPx||40,flexible*0.6);
            var newPx=clamp(startPx+delta,cur.minPx||40,maxNew);
            var out=dragMiddle(cur,newPx,flexible);
            applyWidths(out);
            syncSticky();
        }
    });
    function endDrag(){
        if(!cur)return;
        var wasFixed=cur.fixed;
        cur=null;
        cols.forEach(function(c){var h=c.th.querySelector('.ov-resize-handle');if(h)h.style.background='';});
        if(wasFixed){
            localStorage.setItem(FIXED_KEY,JSON.stringify(readFixed()));
        }else{
            var fixed=readFixed();
            var tw=tableW()||1100;
            var flexible=tw-fixedTotal(fixed);
            var obj={};
            middle.forEach(function(c){obj[c.key]=(flexible>0)?curPx(c)/flexible:0;});
            localStorage.setItem(MID_KEY,JSON.stringify(obj));
        }
    }
    document.addEventListener('mouseup',endDrag);
    document.addEventListener('mouseleave',endDrag);
    window.addEventListener('blur',endDrag);
    window.addEventListener('resize',function(){if(!cur&&table.offsetParent)layout();});
    // 容器尺寸变化时自动重排列宽（覆盖标签模式 iframe 尺寸延迟定型、tab 切换后布局变化等情况）
    if (typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined') {
        var ro = new ResizeObserver(function(){ if(table.offsetParent) layout(); });
        var roTarget = table.closest('.table-responsive') || table;
        ro.observe(roTarget);
    }
    // 动态悬浮阴影：中间列滚动到吸顶列下方时浮出
    var scroller=table.closest('.table-responsive');
    function updateShadow(){
        if(!scroller)return;
        var sl=scroller.scrollLeft;
        var maxSl=scroller.scrollWidth-scroller.clientWidth;
        table.classList.toggle('ov-scrolled-left',sl>4);
        table.classList.toggle('ov-scrolled-right',sl<maxSl-4);
    }
    if(scroller){scroller.addEventListener('scroll',updateShadow,{passive:true});}
    updateShadow();
})();

function showCalPopup(el,date){

},80)}

var lightboxImages=[],lightboxIdx=0;
var lbScale=1,lbTx=0,lbTy=0,lbDragging=false,lbHasDragged=false,lbStartX,lbStartY;
function lbUpdate() {
    var img = document.getElementById('lightboxImage');
    if (!img) return;
    img.style.transform = 'translate('+lbTx+'px,'+lbTy+'px) scale('+lbScale+')';
    img.style.transition = lbDragging ? 'none' : 'transform .2s';
    img.style.cursor = lbDragging ? 'grabbing' : (lbScale > 1.01 ? 'grab' : 'zoom-in');
}
function lbZoomIn(){lbScale=2;lbTx=0;lbTy=0;lbUpdate();}
function lbZoomOut(){lbScale=1;lbTx=0;lbTy=0;lbUpdate();}
function showLightbox(url,images){
    if(Array.isArray(images)&&images.length>1){
        lightboxImages=images;lightboxIdx=lightboxImages.indexOf(url);if(lightboxIdx<0)lightboxIdx=0;
        document.getElementById('lightboxPrev').style.display='';document.getElementById('lightboxNext').style.display='';
        document.getElementById('lightboxCounter').textContent=(lightboxIdx+1)+' / '+lightboxImages.length;

    var img = document.getElementById('lightboxImage');

    lbScale=1;lbTx=0;lbTy=0;lbDragging=false;lbHasDragged=false;
    img.style.transform='scale(1)';img.style.transition='transform .2s';img.style.cursor='zoom-in';
    new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('lightboxModal')).show();
}
function lightboxNav(dir){if(!lightboxImages||lightboxImages.length<=1)return;
    lightboxIdx+=dir;if(lightboxIdx<0)lightboxIdx=lightboxImages.length-1;if(lightboxIdx>=lightboxImages.length)lightboxIdx=0;
    var img = document.getElementById('lightboxImage');
    img.src=lightboxImages[lightboxIdx];
    lbScale=1;lbTx=0;lbTy=0;lbDragging=false;lbHasDragged=false;
    img.style.transform='scale(1)';img.style.transition='transform .2s';img.style.cursor='zoom-in';
    document.getElementById('lightboxCounter').textContent=(lightboxIdx+1)+' / '+lightboxImages.length;
}
// Zoom/drag: click to toggle, wheel to zoom, drag to pan
document.getElementById('lightboxImage').addEventListener('click',function(e){
    if(lbHasDragged){lbHasDragged=false;return;}
    lbScale>1.01?lbZoomOut():lbZoomIn();
});
document.getElementById('lightboxImage').addEventListener('wheel',function(e){
    e.preventDefault();
    var ns=Math.round((lbScale-e.deltaY*0.001)*10)/10;
    ns=Math.max(0.5,Math.min(4,ns));
    if(ns!==lbScale){lbScale=ns;if(lbScale<=1.01){lbTx=0;lbTy=0;}lbUpdate();}
},{passive:false});
document.getElementById('lightboxImage').addEventListener('mousedown',function(e){
    if(lbScale<=1.01)return;
    e.preventDefault();
    lbDragging=true;lbStartX=e.clientX-lbTx;lbStartY=e.clientY-lbTy;
    lbUpdate();
});
document.addEventListener('mousemove',function(e){
    if(!lbDragging)return;
    lbTx=e.clientX-lbStartX;lbTy=e.clientY-lbStartY;

});
document.addEventListener('mouseup',function(){lbDragging=false;lbUpdate();});
// Reset zoom when lightbox closes
document.getElementById('lightboxModal').addEventListener('hidden.bs.modal',function(){

});

// ===== File upload preview (single source of truth: _fileStore array) =====
function previewFiles(input, containerId) {
    var container = document.getElementById(containerId);
    if (!container) return;
    if (!input._fileStore) input._fileStore = [];
    // Merge genuinely new files from input.files (browser file dialog) into _fileStore
    if (input.files && input.files.length > 0) {
        for (var i = 0; i < input.files.length; i++) {
            var f = input.files[i], dup = false;
            for (var j = 0; j < input._fileStore.length; j++) {
                if (input._fileStore[j].name === f.name && input._fileStore[j].size === f.size && input._fileStore[j].lastModified === f.lastModified) { dup = true; break; }
            }
            if (!dup) input._fileStore.push(f);
        }
    }
    // Rebuild input.files from _fileStore for form submission
    var dt = new DataTransfer();
    for (var i = 0; i < input._fileStore.length; i++) dt.items.add(input._fileStore[i]);
    input.files = dt.files;
    // Render previews
    container.innerHTML = '';
    input._fileStore.forEach(function(file, idx) {
        var wrapper = document.createElement('div');
        wrapper.className = 'position-relative';
        wrapper.style.cssText = 'display:inline-block;';
        if (!file.type.startsWith('image/')) {
            var div = document.createElement('div');
            div.className = 'border rounded p-1 d-flex align-items-center justify-content-center';
            div.style.cssText = 'width:80px;height:80px;';
            div.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-file-pdf text-danger" style="font-size:1.5rem;"></i>';
            wrapper.appendChild(div);
            wrapper.appendChild(createRemoveBtn(idx, input));
            container.appendChild(wrapper);
            return;
        }
        // IIFE to capture idx for async reader.onload
        (function(w, ix, inp) {
            var reader = new FileReader();
            reader.onload = function(e) {
                var div = document.createElement('div');
                div.className = 'border rounded p-1';
                div.style.cssText = 'width:80px;height:80px;';
                div.innerHTML = '<img src="'+e.target.result+'" style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;border-radius:4px;">';
                w.appendChild(div);
                w.appendChild(createRemoveBtn(ix, inp));
                container.appendChild(w);
            };
            reader.readAsDataURL(file);
        })(wrapper, idx, input);
    });
}
function createRemoveBtn(idx, input) {
    var btn = document.createElement('span');
    btn.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;top:-8px;right:-8px;width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;background:#ef4444;color:#fff;border:none;font-size:12px;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;';
    btn.innerHTML = '×';
    btn.onclick = function() {
        input._fileStore.splice(idx, 1);
        var syncDt = new DataTransfer();
        for (var i = 0; i < input._fileStore.length; i++) syncDt.items.add(input._fileStore[i]);
        input.files = syncDt.files;
        previewFiles(input, this.parentElement.parentElement.id);
    };
    return btn;
}
// Paste image files into a label's file input — shared by inline handler and document listener
function pasteImageToLabel(label, items) {
    var input = label.querySelector('input[type="file"]');
    if (!input) return;
    if (!input._fileStore) input._fileStore = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
        if (items[i].type.indexOf('image') !== 0) continue;
        var blob = items[i].getAsFile();
        var file = new File([blob], 'paste-' + Date.now() + '.png', { type: blob.type });
        input._fileStore.push(file);
    }
    var dt = new DataTransfer();
    for (var j = 0; j < input._fileStore.length; j++) dt.items.add(input._fileStore[j]);
    input.files = dt.files;
    var container = input.parentElement.nextElementSibling;
    if (container && container.id && container.id.includes('Preview')) {
        previewFiles(input, container.id);
    }
}
// Inline onpaste handler (label-level, fires when label somehow has focus)
function handlePasteUpload(e) {
    e._pasteHandled = true;
    var items = (e.clipboardData || e.originalEvent.clipboardData).items;
    if (!items) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    pasteImageToLabel(e.currentTarget, items);
}
// Track last-hovered upload label for document-level paste support
var _lastUploadLabel = null;
document.addEventListener('mouseover', function(e) {
    var label = e.target.closest('.oms-upload-area-lg');
    if (label) _lastUploadLabel = label;
});
document.addEventListener('paste', function(e) {
    if (e._pasteHandled) return;
    var items = (e.clipboardData || e.originalEvent.clipboardData).items;
    if (!items) return;
    var hasImage = false;
    for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
        if (items[i].type.indexOf('image') === 0) { hasImage = true; break; }
    }
    if (!hasImage) return;
    var ae = document.activeElement;
    if (ae && (ae.tagName === 'INPUT' || ae.tagName === 'TEXTAREA' || ae.tagName === 'SELECT' || ae.isContentEditable)) return;
    var label = _lastUploadLabel;
    if (!label || label.offsetParent === null) {
        var labels = document.querySelectorAll('.oms-upload-area-lg');
        for (var j = 0; j < labels.length; j++) {
            if (labels[j].offsetParent !== null) { label = labels[j]; break; }
        }
    }
    if (!label) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    pasteImageToLabel(label, items);
});

<script>
// ===== iframe 嵌入检测：隐藏布局元素 + 禁用标签模式 =====
var isEmbedded = window !== window.top;
// 通知轮询：仅非嵌入模式执行
if (!isEmbedded) {
    setInterval(fetchNotifications, 60000);
    fetchNotifications();
}

if (isEmbedded) {
    // 登录过期 → 全页跳转到登录
    if (window.location.pathname.indexOf('/login') === 0) {
        window.top.location.href = '/login';
    }
    // 403 → 通知父页面
    if (document.title === '无权访问') {
        window.parent.postMessage({ type: 'tabError', error: 'forbidden' }, window.location.origin);
    }

    // 拦截 iframe 内链接点击，通知父页面创建新标签
    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        var a = e.target.closest('a');
        if (!a) return;
        if (a.getAttribute('data-bs-toggle') || a.getAttribute('data-bs-dismiss') || a.getAttribute('onclick') || a.getAttribute('target') || a.hasAttribute('download')) return;
        var href = a.getAttribute('href');
        if (!href || href === '#' || href.startsWith('javascript:') || href.startsWith('mailto:') || href.startsWith('tel:')) return;
        // 本站绝对 URL 转为相对路径
        if (href.startsWith(window.location.origin)) href = href.substring(window.location.origin.length);
        // 外部链接不拦截，让浏览器正常处理
        if (href.startsWith('http://') || href.startsWith('https://') || href.startsWith('//')) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        var title = (a.textContent || '').trim().substring(0, 30) || document.title;
        window.parent.postMessage({ type: 'openTab', url: href, title: title }, window.location.origin);
    });
}

// ===== 标签页导航 =====
var tabMode = localStorage.getItem('tabMode') === '1';
var tabs = [];
var activeTabId = null;
var _rsListeners = [];

function saveTabs() {
    var data = tabs.map(function(t){ return {id:t.id,url:t.url,title:t.title}; });
    sessionStorage.setItem('tabs', JSON.stringify(data));
    sessionStorage.setItem('activeTab', activeTabId);
}

function loadTabs() {
    try {
        var d = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('tabs') || '[]');
        tabs = d.map(function(t){ return {id:t.id,url:t.url,title:t.id==='dashboard'?'仪表盘':t.title,iframe:null}; });
        activeTabId = sessionStorage.getItem('activeTab') || null;
    } catch(e) { tabs = []; activeTabId = null; }
}

function toggleTabMode() {
    tabMode = !tabMode;
    localStorage.setItem('tabMode', tabMode ? '1' : '0');
    applyTabMode();
}

function applyTabMode() {
    var btn = document.getElementById('tabModeToggle');
    var bar = document.getElementById('tabBar');
    var tc = document.getElementById('tabContent');
    var nc = document.getElementById('normalContent');

    document.body.classList.toggle('tab-mode-active', tabMode);
    if (tabMode) {
        btn.classList.add('active');
        bar.classList.remove('hidden');
        tc.classList.remove('hidden');
        // 切到标签模式先回顶部，避免 .main 残留滚动；tabContent 高度由 CSS flex 自动填充，无需 JS 量算
        var mainEl = document.querySelector('.main');
        if (mainEl) mainEl.scrollTop = 0;
        tc.style.height = '';
        nc.style.display = 'none';
        loadTabs();
        if (tabs.length === 0) {
            openTab('/', '仪表盘');
        } else {
            var act = tabs.find(function(t){ return t.id === activeTabId; }) || tabs[0];
            switchTab(act.id, false);
        }
        renderTabs();
    } else {
        btn.classList.remove('active');
        bar.classList.add('hidden');
        tc.classList.add('hidden');
        tc.style.height = '';
        nc.style.display = '';
        tc.innerHTML = '';
        _rsListeners.forEach(function(fn){ window.removeEventListener('resize', fn); });
        _rsListeners = [];
    }
}

function renderTabs() {
    var list = document.getElementById('tabList');
    list.innerHTML = '';
    tabs.forEach(function(t) {
        var el = document.createElement('div');
        el.className = 'tab-item' + (t.id === activeTabId ? ' active' : '') + (t.id === 'dashboard' ? ' pinned' : '');
        el.title = t.title || t.url;
        el.innerHTML = '<span style="overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;">' + (t.title || t.url || '新标签') + '</span>' +
            (t.id !== 'dashboard' ? '<span class="tab-close" onclick="event.stopPropagation();closeTab(\'' + t.id + '\')">×</span>' : '');
        el.onclick = function() { switchTab(t.id); };
        list.appendChild(el);
    });
}

function openTab(url, title) {
    var id = url === '/' ? 'dashboard' : 'tab_' + Date.now();
    var existing = tabs.find(function(t){ return t.url === url; });
    if (existing) { var ef = document.getElementById('tabContent').querySelector('iframe[data-tab-id="' + existing.id + '"]'); if (ef) ef.contentWindow.location.reload(); switchTab(existing.id); return; }
    // 标签上限 8，超限关闭最早的非仪表盘标签
    if (tabs.length >= 8) {
        var oldest = tabs.find(function(t){ return t.id !== 'dashboard'; });
        if (oldest) closeTab(oldest.id);
    }
    tabs.push({ id:id, url:url, title:title || '', iframe:null });
    activeTabId = id;
    switchTab(id);
    renderTabs();
    saveTabs();
}

function switchTab(id, render) {
    if (render === undefined) render = true;
    activeTabId = id;
    var t = tabs.find(function(t){ return t.id === id; });
    if (!t) return;
    if (render) renderTabs();
    saveTabs();

    // 更新侧边栏高亮 — 按路径前缀最长匹配
    var sideLinks = document.querySelectorAll('#sidebar a.nav-link');
    for (var i = 0; i < sideLinks.length; i++) sideLinks[i].classList.remove('active');
    var targetPath = t.url.replace(/^https?:\/\/[^\/]+/, '').replace(/\/$/, '') || '/';
    var best = null, bestLen = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < sideLinks.length; i++) {
        var l = sideLinks[i];
        var h = (l.getAttribute('href') || '').replace(/^https?:\/\/[^\/]+/, '').replace(/\/$/, '') || '/';
        if (targetPath === '/' && h === '/') { best = l; break; }
        if (h !== '/' && targetPath.startsWith(h) && h.length > bestLen) { best = l; bestLen = h.length; }
    }
    if (best) best.classList.add('active');

    var tc = document.getElementById('tabContent');
    if (!tc.classList.contains('hidden')) { var top = tc.getBoundingClientRect().top; tc.style.height = (window.innerHeight - top) + 'px'; }

    var existing = tc.querySelector('iframe[data-tab-id="' + id + '"]');
    if (existing) {
        tc.querySelectorAll('iframe').forEach(function(f){ f.style.display = 'none'; });
        existing.style.display = 'block';
        return;
    }

    tc.querySelectorAll('iframe').forEach(function(f){ f.style.display = 'none'; });
    var frame = document.createElement('iframe');
    frame.setAttribute('data-tab-id', id);
    frame.src = t.url;
    frame.className = 'oms-tab-iframe';
    frame.onload = function() { renderTabs(); saveTabs(); };
    tc.appendChild(frame);
    t.iframe = frame;
}

function closeTab(id) {
    var idx = tabs.findIndex(function(t){ return t.id === id; });
    if (idx < 0 || tabs[idx].id === 'dashboard') return;
    var tc = document.getElementById('tabContent');
    var frame = tc.querySelector('iframe[data-tab-id="' + id + '"]');
    if (frame) frame.remove();
    tabs.splice(idx, 1);
    if (activeTabId === id) {
        activeTabId = tabs[tabs.length - 1] ? tabs[tabs.length - 1].id : null;
        if (activeTabId) switchTab(activeTabId);
    }
    renderTabs();
    saveTabs();
}

// 拦截侧边栏链接
document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    if (!tabMode) return;
    var a = e.target.closest('.sidebar a.nav-link');
    if (!a) return;
    var href = a.getAttribute('href');
    if (!href || href === '#' || href.startsWith('javascript:')) return;
    // 本站绝对 URL 转为相对路径
    if (href.startsWith(window.location.origin)) href = href.substring(window.location.origin.length);
    if (href.startsWith('http://') || href.startsWith('https://') || href.startsWith('//')) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    var url = href || '/';
    var title = (a.textContent || '').trim().replace(/\n/g,'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').substring(0,30);
    openTab(url, title);
});

// 监听 iframe 内的导航消息
window.addEventListener('message', function(e) {

// ===== 通用输入框实时查重 =====
function checkUnique(table, field, value, warnId, excludeId) {
    if (!value || value.length < 2) { var el = document.getElementById(warnId); if (el) el.style.display = 'none'; return; }
    var url = 'https://trip.lipseo.com/check-unique?table=' + table + '&field=' + field + '&value=' + encodeURIComponent(value);
    if (excludeId) url += '&exclude_id=' + excludeId;
    fetch(url).then(function (r) { return r.json() }).then(function (d) {
        var el = document.getElementById(warnId); if (el) el.style.display = d.exists ? '' : 'none';
    });
}
// ===== Toast notification system =====
function showToast(message, type = 'success') {
    const container = document.getElementById('toastContainer');
    const toast = document.createElement('div');
    toast.className = `toast-custom ${type}`;
    const icon = type === 'success' ? 'bi-check-circle-fill text-success' : 'bi-exclamation-triangle-fill text-danger';
    toast.innerHTML = `<i class="bi ${icon}"></i><span>${message}</span>`;
    container.appendChild(toast);
    setTimeout(() => { toast.style.opacity = '0'; toast.style.transition = 'opacity .3s'; setTimeout(() => toast.remove(), 300); }, 5000);
}

// ===== Confirmation dialog =====
function confirmAction(message, callback) {
    if (confirm(message)) callback();
}

        setTimeout(function() { el.classList.remove('show'); setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 300); }, 6000);
    });
});

// ===== 自定义日期选择器 (零依赖) =====
(function() {
    var MONTHS = ['一月','二月','三月','四月','五月','六月','七月','八月','九月','十月','十一月','十二月'];
    var WEEKDAYS = ['一','二','三','四','五','六','日'];

    function ymd(d) { return d.getFullYear()+'-'+String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0'); }
    function parse(v) { if (!v) return new Date(); var p = v.split('-'); return new Date(+p[0], +p[1]-1, +p[2]); }

    function buildCalendar(input) {
        var cal = document.createElement('div'); cal.className = 'dtp-calendar';

        // Header
        var hdr = document.createElement('div'); hdr.className = 'dtp-header';
        var prevYear = document.createElement('button'); prevYear.className = 'dtp-arrow dtp-double'; prevYear.innerHTML = '«'; prevYear.title = '上一年';
        var prevMonth = document.createElement('button'); prevMonth.className = 'dtp-arrow'; prevMonth.innerHTML = '‹'; prevMonth.title = '上一月';
        var labelArea = document.createElement('div'); labelArea.className = 'dtp-label-area';
        var yearLabel = document.createElement('span'); yearLabel.className = 'dtp-label';
        var monthLabel = document.createElement('span'); monthLabel.className = 'dtp-label';
        labelArea.appendChild(monthLabel); labelArea.appendChild(yearLabel);
        var nextMonth = document.createElement('button'); nextMonth.className = 'dtp-arrow'; nextMonth.innerHTML = '›'; nextMonth.title = '下一月';
        var nextYear = document.createElement('button'); nextYear.className = 'dtp-arrow dtp-double'; nextYear.innerHTML = '»'; nextYear.title = '下一年';
        hdr.appendChild(prevYear); hdr.appendChild(prevMonth);
        hdr.appendChild(labelArea);
        hdr.appendChild(nextMonth); hdr.appendChild(nextYear);

        // Select panels
        var monthPanel = document.createElement('div'); monthPanel.className = 'dtp-select-panel';
        var monthGrid = document.createElement('div'); monthGrid.className = 'dtp-select-grid months';
        monthPanel.appendChild(monthGrid);
        var yearPanel = document.createElement('div'); yearPanel.className = 'dtp-select-panel';
        var yearGrid = document.createElement('div'); yearGrid.className = 'dtp-select-grid years';
        yearPanel.appendChild(yearGrid);

        // Weekday row
        var wkRow = document.createElement('div'); wkRow.className = 'dtp-weekdays';
        WEEKDAYS.forEach(function(d) { var s = document.createElement('span'); s.textContent = d; wkRow.appendChild(s); });

        // Day grid
        var dayGrid = document.createElement('div'); dayGrid.className = 'dtp-days';

        // Footer
        var footer = document.createElement('div'); footer.className = 'dtp-footer';
        var clearBtn = document.createElement('button'); clearBtn.textContent = '清除'; clearBtn.type = 'button';
        var todayBtn = document.createElement('button'); todayBtn.textContent = '今天'; todayBtn.className = 'dtp-today'; todayBtn.type = 'button';
        footer.appendChild(clearBtn); footer.appendChild(todayBtn);

        cal.appendChild(hdr); cal.appendChild(monthPanel); cal.appendChild(yearPanel);
        cal.appendChild(wkRow); cal.appendChild(dayGrid); cal.appendChild(footer);
        document.body.appendChild(cal);

        var state = { year: 0, month: 0, day: 0, showMonthPanel: false, showYearPanel: false };

        function hidePanels() { monthPanel.classList.remove('show'); yearPanel.classList.remove('show'); state.showMonthPanel = false; state.showYearPanel = false; }

        function renderDays() {
            yearLabel.textContent = state.year + '年';
            monthLabel.textContent = MONTHS[state.month];

            // Month select panel
            monthGrid.innerHTML = '';
            MONTHS.forEach(function(m, i) {
                var btn = document.createElement('button'); btn.textContent = (i+1) + '月'; btn.type = 'button';
                if (i === state.month) btn.classList.add('active');
                btn.addEventListener('click', function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); state.month = i; hidePanels(); renderDays(); });
                monthGrid.appendChild(btn);
            });

            // Year select panel
            yearGrid.innerHTML = '';
            var yStart = state.year - 5;
            for (var i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
                var y = yStart + i;
                var btn = document.createElement('button'); btn.textContent = y; btn.type = 'button';
                if (y === state.year) btn.classList.add('active');
                (function(yy) {
                    btn.addEventListener('click', function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); state.year = yy; hidePanels(); renderDays(); });
                })(y);
                yearGrid.appendChild(btn);
            }

            // Day cells
            dayGrid.innerHTML = '';
            var firstDay = new Date(state.year, state.month, 1);
            var startDay = firstDay.getDay() || 7; // Mon=1..Sun=7
            var daysInMonth = new Date(state.year, state.month + 1, 0).getDate();
            var prevDays = new Date(state.year, state.month, 0).getDate();
            var today = new Date(); today.setHours(0,0,0,0);

            // Previous month fill
            for (var i = startDay - 2; i >= 0; i--) {
                var d = prevDays - i;
                var btn = document.createElement('button'); btn.textContent = d; btn.type = 'button';
                btn.classList.add('other-month');
                (function(yy, mm, dd) {
                    btn.addEventListener('click', function() { state.year = yy; state.month = mm; state.day = dd; selectDate(); });
                })(state.month === 0 ? state.year - 1 : state.year, state.month === 0 ? 11 : state.month - 1, d);
                dayGrid.appendChild(btn);
            }

            // Current month
            for (var i = 1; i <= daysInMonth; i++) {
                var btn = document.createElement('button'); btn.textContent = i; btn.type = 'button';
                var cellDate = new Date(state.year, state.month, i); cellDate.setHours(0,0,0,0);
                if (cellDate.getTime() === today.getTime()) btn.classList.add('today');
                if (i === state.day) btn.classList.add('selected');
                (function(dd) {
                    btn.addEventListener('click', function() { state.day = dd; selectDate(); });
                })(i);
                dayGrid.appendChild(btn);
            }

            // Next month fill
            var remaining = 42 - (startDay - 1) - daysInMonth;
            for (var i = 1; i <= remaining; i++) {
                var btn = document.createElement('button'); btn.textContent = i; btn.type = 'button';
                btn.classList.add('other-month');
                (function(yy, mm, dd) {
                    btn.addEventListener('click', function() { state.year = yy; state.month = mm; state.day = dd; selectDate(); });
                })(state.month === 11 ? state.year + 1 : state.year, state.month === 11 ? 0 : state.month + 1, i);
                dayGrid.appendChild(btn);
            }
        }

        function selectDate() {
            if (!state.day) { state.day = new Date(state.year, state.month + 1, 0).getDate(); }
            input.value = state.year + '-' + String(state.month + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '-' + String(state.day).padStart(2, '0');
            hidePanels();
            renderDays();
            cal.classList.remove('show');
            input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
        }

        // Event handlers
        prevYear.addEventListener('click', function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); state.year--; state.day = 0; renderDays(); });
        prevMonth.addEventListener('click', function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); state.month--; if (state.month < 0) { state.month = 11; state.year--; } state.day = 0; renderDays(); });
        nextMonth.addEventListener('click', function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); state.month++; if (state.month > 11) { state.month = 0; state.year++; } state.day = 0; renderDays(); });
        nextYear.addEventListener('click', function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); state.year++; state.day = 0; renderDays(); });

        monthLabel.addEventListener('click', function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); yearPanel.classList.remove('show'); state.showYearPanel = false; monthPanel.classList.toggle('show'); state.showMonthPanel = !state.showMonthPanel; });
        yearLabel.addEventListener('click', function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); monthPanel.classList.remove('show'); state.showMonthPanel = false; yearPanel.classList.toggle('show'); state.showYearPanel = !state.showYearPanel; });

        todayBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); var t = new Date(); state.year = t.getFullYear(); state.month = t.getMonth(); state.day = t.getDate(); selectDate(); });
        clearBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); input.value = ''; state.day = 0; hidePanels(); cal.classList.remove('show'); renderDays(); input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); });

        input.addEventListener('click', function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); show(); });
        input.addEventListener('focus', function(e) { show(); });

        document.addEventListener('click', function(e) { if (!cal.contains(e.target) && e.target !== input) { cal.classList.remove('show'); hidePanels(); } });

        function show() {
            if (cal.classList.contains('show')) return;
            var rect = input.getBoundingClientRect();
            cal.style.top = (rect.bottom + window.scrollY + 4) + 'px';
            cal.style.left = (rect.left + window.scrollX) + 'px';
            if (rect.bottom + 400 > window.innerHeight) cal.style.top = (rect.top + window.scrollY - 400 - 4) + 'px';
            if (rect.left + 300 > window.innerWidth) cal.style.left = (rect.right + window.scrollX - 296) + 'px';

            // Init state from input value
            var d = input.value ? parse(input.value) : new Date();
            state.year = d.getFullYear(); state.month = d.getMonth(); state.day = d.getDate();
            renderDays();
            cal.classList.add('show');
            hidePanels();
            // Close other calendars
            document.querySelectorAll('.dtp-calendar.show').forEach(function(c) { if (c !== cal) c.classList.remove('show'); });
        }

        return cal;
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        document.querySelectorAll('.datepicker').forEach(function(input) {
            if (input._dtpInited) return; input._dtpInited = true;
            buildCalendar(input);
        });
    });
})();

// ===== 通用可搜索下拉（searchable-select 公共组件，全局定义，页面可覆盖）=====
function toggleDropdown(id){var dd=document.getElementById(id).querySelector('.searchable-dropdown'),o=dd.classList.contains('show');closeAllDropdowns();if(!o){dd.classList.add('show');var inp=dd.querySelector('.searchable-input');if(inp){inp.focus({preventScroll:true});inp.select();filterDropdown(id,'')}}}

function closeAllDropdowns(){document.querySelectorAll('.searchable-dropdown.show').forEach(function(d){d.classList.remove('show')})}
function filterDropdown(id,kw){var c=document.getElementById(id);if(!c)return;var kwl=(kw||'').toLowerCase();var hook=c.getAttribute('data-filter-hook'),fn=hook&&window[hook]?window[hook]:null;var has=false;c.querySelectorAll('.searchable-option').forEach(function(o){var ok=fn?fn(o,kwl):(!kwl||o.textContent.toLowerCase().indexOf(kwl)>=0);o.style.display=ok?'':'none';if(ok)has=true});var e=c.querySelector('.searchable-empty');if(!has){if(!e){e=document.createElement('div');e.className='searchable-empty';e.textContent='无匹配';c.querySelector('.searchable-options').appendChild(e)}e.style.display=''}else if(e){e.style.display='none'}}
function selectDropdown(id,option){var c=document.getElementById(id);if(!c)return;var v=option.getAttribute('data-value')||'';var label=option.getAttribute('data-label')||option.textContent.trim();var te=c.querySelector('.searchable-text');if(te){te.textContent=label||'请选择';te.classList.toggle('has-value',!!v)}var hidden=c.querySelector('input[type=hidden]');if(hidden)hidden.value=v;var map=c.getAttribute('data-map');if(map){map.split(',').forEach(function(pair){var p=pair.split(':');if(p.length===2){var el=document.getElementById(p[1].trim());if(el)el.value=option.getAttribute('data-'+p[0].trim())||''}})}c.querySelectorAll('.searchable-option').forEach(function(o){o.classList.remove('selected')});option.classList.add('selected');c.querySelector('.searchable-dropdown').classList.remove('show');var inp=c.querySelector('.searchable-input');if(inp)inp.value='';var hook=c.getAttribute('data-select-hook');if(hook&&window[hook])window[hook](option,v);if(c.getAttribute('data-submit')==='1'&&c.closest('form'))c.closest('form').submit()}
document.addEventListener('click',function(e){if(!e.target.closest('.searchable-select'))closeAllDropdowns()});
</script>
